{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 视频皮肤：聊天背景 + 有声开机动画 + 界面内透明度调节","id":"gh:1401755814","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-video-skin","slug":"Something11235/dsh-video-skin","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH 视频皮肤：聊天背景 + 有声开机动画 + 界面内透明度调节"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-video-skin"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**DSH 视频皮肤**：一段短片循环铺成整个界面的**聊天背景**（无声、透明度界面里就能调），
另一段做**有声的开机动画**（片尾交叉溶解进界面、**点击画面随时跳过**）。**零依赖**。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## 安装（Install）"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，把下面这一行贴进输入框，点「安装」，然后**完全退出并重新打开 DSH**："},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Prebuilt on npm (current latest `0.1.6`); `dsh-video-skin` without a version follows latest.
- Fro"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"m source: `github:Something11235/dsh-video-skin#main`"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> 桌面版（Electron）的索引注入表是**宿主启动时收集一次**的快照，所以装完必须**完全重启 DSH**
> 才会生效（刷新页面不够）。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile <你"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"的 profile> remove dsh-video-skin`，
> 或者用仓库里的 `scripts/uninstall.ps1`。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"装好之后：右下角会出现一个半透明小圆钮，点开就是**透明度滑块**（调完刷新还在，不用重启）；
启动时会先播放开机动画，**点一下画面**就跳过。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"English: install `github:Something11235/dsh-video-skin#main` from **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin*"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"*,
then **fully quit and relaunch DSH**. A small pill appears in the bottom-right corner for the
tra"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"nsparency sliders; click anywhere during the boot animation to skip it."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"A **video skin** for DSH: one clip becomes a looping, silent **video backdrop** behind the whole Web"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" UI,
and a second clip becomes a **boot animation** — **played with sound**, **played through to its"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" end**,
then fading into the app, and **skippable with a click**."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- Boot animation: full-window clip **with audio**, a progress bar driven by the kernel's real activa"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"tion
progress, and a permanent “click to skip” pill. The clip **finishes first** (`ended`), then the"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" overlay
fades out over a **fixed** `fadeMs`; the volume fades with it instead of being cut off.
> E"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"arlier builds cross-dissolved over the clip's tail and used the *actual remaining time* as the fade
"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"> duration — when the app became ready late that left only 100–200 ms, which read as a **hard cut**."},{"id":"p12s6","text":"
> Default is now `exitMode: 'end'`; `exitMode: 'tail'` restores the crossfade (still with a fixed f"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ade).
- Backdrop: silent, looping, `object-fit: cover`, with the **canvas and sidebar** surface toke"},{"id":"p12s8","text":": silent, looping, `object-fit: cover`, with the **canvas and sidebar** surface tokens made

That layer used to be `layer-2` at alpha 0.36 (the worst case) and let "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"the
chat text show straight through the dialog; it now keeps the kernel's native opaque colour."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Sound"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The desktop shell sets no `webPreferences.autoplayPolicy`, so Electron's default
(`no-user-gesture-r"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"equired`) applies: an unmuted `play()` succeeds and the boot animation starts with
sound. A plain br"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"owser (`dsh web` in Chrome) blocks unmuted autoplay by default; the runtime then
**falls back to mut"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ed playback** (never trapping you on a dead screen) and shows a **separate** sound
button in the bot"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"tom-left — clicking it turns sound on without skipping, so the two intents never
collide. Set `boot."},{"id":"p18s6","text":"sound: false` for a silent boot."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Transparency"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`surface` (dark theme) and `surfaceLight` (light theme) are the two knobs that trade picture strengt"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"h
against readability; `veil` / `veilLight` are the scrims over the video. They are deliberately dif"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ferent
per theme: text is light in dark mode and dark in light mode, and this asset is dark (`YAVG ≈"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" 0.25`), so
an equally thin *white* surface drops dark text below 3:1. Measured in a real browser:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `surface` | `surfaceLight` | dark min / p5 / median | light min / p5 / median |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| **0.2** | **0.6** | **2.49 / 6.81 / 16.05** | **7.74 / 7.91 / 8.72** |
| 0.2 | 0.4 | 2.52 / 6.85 /"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" 16.06 | 4.34 / 4.52 / 5.37 |
| 0.05 | 0.6 | 1.53 / 4.89 / 15.24 | 7.38 / 7.56 / 8.37 |
| 0 | 0.55 |"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" 1.22 / 4.14 / 14.71 | 5.87 / 6.06 / 6.90 |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"p5 (the 95% of frame area) is the meaningful readability number; `--sweep` prints this table live."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Tuning it in the UI"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"A small half-transparent pill sits in the bottom-right corner. Clicking it opens a panel with two
sl"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"iders (panel opacity / video scrim), three presets, a **live body-text contrast readout** measured f"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"rom
the current video frame, and a reset button."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Dragging applies immediately; releasing writes to `$DSH_HOME/dsh-video-skin.json` through a
`POST`"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"/`DELETE /dsh-video-skin/override` route. Only those four knobs are written; everything else in
the "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"file is preserved. A **refresh** picks the values up (no DSH restart), and the file stays
hand-edita"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ble.
- A file rather than `localStorage`: the desktop page is served from the `dsh-app://` scheme, w"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"here Web
Storage availability is not guaranteed.
- If the write fails (read-only home), the panel sa"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"ys so — it does not pretend to have saved.
- `Esc` or a click outside closes the panel; `Alt+B` togg"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"les it; `background.controls: false` removes it.
- The pill sits at `z-index: 900`, **below** the ke"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"rnel's `Modal` overlay (1000) on purpose: a modal
should cover everything, and a wallpaper control m"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"ust not steal its clicks."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"**A full restart of DSH is required.** The desktop (Electron) shell serves a static `index.html` and"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"
collects the index-injection table **once at host startup**, with no refresh path; `tapIndex` never"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"
applies there. So a newly installed plugin's injection rows only reach the page on the next launch."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Configure"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Defaults work as shipped. To tune, write either file (the second wins):"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- `<plugin>/video-skin.config.json`
- `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-video-skin.json`"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Changes apply on page refresh. On the desktop shell the boot-animation fields are baked into the
sta"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"rtup snapshot, so those need a restart."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"`veil` (scrim over the video) and `surface` (opacity of the app's `--dsw-alias-*` surfaces) are the "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"two
knobs that trade picture strength against text readability."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## How it is wired"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Three constraints that must not be broken (each one was paid for):"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
